description: Start an order and get a Stripe payment link. Nothing is charged here: the person opens the link and pays on Stripe's page, and gets the report by email. Give the person the link and the price. Keep the order_key to follow the order. With compare_with_place_id (a business of the same trade in the same suburb): two reports and a comparison.

compare_with_place_id.description: Optional. A second business to compare with.

trade_questions.description: Optional. Labels of the trade questions from get_questions. Without it: the usual 2. The 8 general questions are always asked; 16 questions at most.

name: order_report
title: Order a report
